description_en: Queries the information about the project and change base database of a schema design ticket, such as the state of the ticket, the ID of the user who created the ticket, and the name and ID of the change base database
description_zh: 调用此API可获取指定结构设计工单的项目信息以及工单的变更基准库的信息，包含结构设计工单的状态、工单创建者ID、基准库的名称和ID等
name: GetTableDesignProjectInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the schema design ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465867.html operation to obtain the ID
